It was contested by [[Limerick county hurling team|Limerick]] and [[Waterford county hurling team|Waterford]]. Waterford claimed their third Munster Championship of the decade, beating Limerick on a scoreline of 3-17 to 1-14, a 9-point winning margin.{{Cite web|url=https://www.independent.ie/sport/hurling/dynamic-dan-adds-some-extra-dash-for-the-deise-26443514.html|title=Dynamic Dan adds some extra dash for the Déise|website=independent|access-date=11 June 2021|archive-date=10 October 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121010232055/http://www.independent.ie/sport/hurling/dynamic-dan-adds-some-extra-dash-for-the-dise-995588.html|url-status=live}} Overall, this was Waterford's eighth Munster Senior Hurling Championship. ==Match== ===Details=== {{Football box |date = 8 July
